metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IPOPUB crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group I 2/m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C36 H242 Co12 Dy36 O178 18+,20(N1 O3 1-),22(H2 O1),4(Cl1 1-),6(Na1 1+). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy7 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy9 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Co1 (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co2 (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co3 (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co4 (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Dy1A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy7A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy9A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10A (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11A (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Co1A (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co2A (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co3A (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co4A (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2D (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy3D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10D (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11D (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Co1D (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co3D (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Dy3E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10E (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11E (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Co1E (Co) has 6 O neighbors; Co3E (Co) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 144 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.412-5.361 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 88.51-167.28°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C36H286Cl4N20O260Na6Co12Dy36.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
